protocol.supersedes: v3 (results/p1-test-03-contrast/protocol_used.json; protocol.json stays v3 for the scarce re-execution). v4 keeps every v3 rule and adds the H2 question.
protocol.hypothesis: H2: macros (pairs of tools whose argument slots are structurally related: same object, or directly under it) extracted from the agent's OWN completed training episodes reduce planning cost on unseen test tasks without losing completion. E = C + 20 training episodes' experience + macros; CT = C + the same training experience without macros, so E-CT isolates the macro effect from the extra experience.
protocol.primary: planner predictions per episode, E vs CT, paired by (seed, task)
protocol.decision: H2 GAIN (VALID_BOUNDED_GAIN) if mean predictions E / mean predictions CT <= max_ratio, the per-seed ratio is <= max_ratio in >= seeds_ge seeds, and E-CT strict completion >= -max_loss_pp; NO GAIN if the ratio >= 1.0 or the completion loss exceeds max_loss_pp; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Secondary: C-B (replication of v3 under the same policy and seeds; expected +58 pp), CT-C (value of the 20 training episodes alone), E-C, and rule agreement per condition.
protocol.conditions: A, B, C, CT, E + ORACLE
invalid_if: validity tests not run or failed
source changed during the run (sha256 of the package at start != at end)
known_limits: macros are pairs of consecutive tools only, with argument-level structure (eq/child) and no attribute values
training tasks come from the train split generator (indices 100-119) and are acted by C's frozen rules; CT and E therefore see 20 goal-directed episodes that A, B and C do not
macro instances enlarge the candidate set at every expansion (each instance costs two predictions); whether depth reduction outweighs the larger branching is exactly the question
C strict completion is already 0.94 under the contrast policy, so completion cannot show a large gain; the primary measure is therefore cost at no loss
all v3 known limits apply (blocked structurally 0; B coverage-limited; md objects occur in exploration; dev coverage seen before freezing)
protocol.iteration_cap: P2: H2 is the second of at most 3 single-hypothesis changes (H1 was the first)
